headline: Sveriges Riksbank Raises Policy Rate by 25 Basis Points to 2 Percent
summary: Sveriges Riksbank raised its policy rate by 0.25 percentage points to 2 percent, citing stronger economic activity and cost pressures from supply disruptions driving up inflation.
why: Central bank interest rate hikes are designed to cool inflation by increasing borrowing costs, directly affecting currency strength, bond yields, and commercial lending rates.

impacts.name: Sweden Policy Rate
